extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The Mutual of Omaha plan available in Lee County has a $40 monthly premium, a $480 drug deductible and a $2900 maximum out-of-pocket.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent delivered the TPMO disclaimer before discussing benefits, collected the Scope of Appointment, and scheduled an appointment 4 days from now.
composition.coaching_note: Owen, you mentioned that the Mutual of Omaha plan has a $40 monthly premium, a $480 drug deductible, and a $2900 maximum out-of-pocket. While this is accurate, it would be more helpful to provide a clear explanation of what these costs mean for the customer. For example, you could say, 'This plan has a $40 monthly premium, which is a fixed cost that you'll pay each month. The $480 drug deductible means that you'll pay the first $480 of your prescription costs each year, and then the plan will cover the rest. The $2900 maximum out-of-pocket means that you'll never pay more than $2900 in out-of-pocket costs for the year.'
